The core comparison. Each burned spatial unit is filled with its own mean Balanced RIS, so the reader compares spatial units rather than individual pixels. Left: burned area defined by the fire-reference inventory. Right: burned area defined by model fire-occurrence output. Identical extent, colormap, scale, land-cover definition and unit rule; gray is the eligible area. The fire-reference inventory is incomplete, so area the model flags outside it is not by itself a false positive.

- `units` — nb15_t03_burned_spatial_units
- `RIS` — 0.25 x (severity + persistence + recovery_gap + model_recurrence) at 30 m
